```{python}
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import scanpy as sc
import decoupler as dc
import scipy.sparse as sp
from itertools import permutations
from scipy.stats import ttest_ind, rankdata, t as tdist
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests

# ---------------- settings ----------------
ADATA_PATH  = "2.5_car_no_gd.h5ad"
PATIENT_COL = "Patient"
TIME_COL    = "Timepoint_bin"
SUBSET_COL  = "labels"
SUBSET      = "DN T"
EARLY_LABEL = "Early"
LATE_LABEL  = "Late"
N_SIG       = 50
LFC_MIN     = 1
MIN_FRAC    = 0.05       # keep genes detected in >=5% of early cells
N_PERM      = 10000      # only used if the number of patients is > 8
MIN_SET, MAX_SET = 15, 300
SEED        = 0
rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)

GMT_FILES = {
    "Hallmark":    ("h.all.v2026.1.Hs.symbols.gmt", None),
    "GO_BP":       ("c5.go.bp.v2026.1.Hs.symbols.gmt", None),
    "KEGG":        ("c2.cp.kegg_medicus.v2026.1.Hs.symbols.gmt", None),
    "Reactome":    ("ReactomePathways.gmt", "R-HSA"),
    "ImmuneSigDB": ("c7.immunesigdb.v2026.1.Hs.symbols.gmt", None),
}

def to_dense(X):
    return X.toarray() if hasattr(X, "toarray") else np.asarray(X)

# ---------------- load and define contrasts ----------------
adata = sc.read_h5ad(ADATA_PATH)
obs = adata.obs
is_late_dn = ((obs[TIME_COL] == LATE_LABEL) & (obs[SUBSET_COL] == SUBSET)).values
is_early   = (obs[TIME_COL] == EARLY_LABEL).values
adata.obs["contrast"] = np.where(is_late_dn, "Late_DNT", "other")

# ---------------- signature pseudobulk (summed counts, log-CPM) ----------------
pb = dc.pp.pseudobulk(adata, sample_col=PATIENT_COL, groups_col="contrast",
                      layer="counts", mode="sum")
dc.pp.filter_samples(pb, min_cells=5, min_counts=1000)   # in place
pb_df = pb.to_df()
lib = pb_df.sum(axis=1)
pb_df = np.log1p(pb_df.div(lib, axis=0) * 1e6)
pb_obs = pb.obs.copy()

# ---------------- labeled patients ----------------
early_pats = set(obs.loc[is_early, PATIENT_COL].unique())
late_pats  = set(obs.loc[is_late_dn, PATIENT_COL].unique())
labeled = sorted(early_pats & late_pats)
n = len(labeled)
print(f"{n} labeled patients: {labeled}")

late_dn = adata[is_late_dn].copy()

# ---------------- helpers ----------------
from pydeseq2.dds import DeseqDataSet
from pydeseq2.ds import DeseqStats

# raw summed counts for each patient x group, after filter_samples
counts_all = pb.to_df().round().astype(int)
meta_all = pb_obs[[PATIENT_COL, "contrast"]].copy()
meta_all[PATIENT_COL] = meta_all[PATIENT_COL].astype(str)

def derive_signature_deseq2(train_patients, n_genes=N_SIG):
    """Top-n up and down genes from a paired DESeq2 model (~ Patient + contrast)."""
    meta = meta_all[meta_all[PATIENT_COL].isin(train_patients)].copy()
    if (meta["contrast"] == "Late_DNT").sum() < 2 or (meta["contrast"] == "other").sum() < 2:
        return None
    counts = counts_all.loc[meta.index]
    counts = counts.loc[:, (counts >= 10).sum(axis=0) >= 3]    # drop very sparse genes
    meta["contrast"] = pd.Categorical(meta["contrast"], categories=["other", "Late_DNT"])
    meta[PATIENT_COL] = pd.Categorical(meta[PATIENT_COL])

    dds = DeseqDataSet(counts=counts, metadata=meta,
                       design="~ Patient + contrast", quiet=True)
    dds.deseq2()
    ds = DeseqStats(dds, contrast=["contrast", "Late_DNT", "other"], quiet=True)
    ds.summary()
    res = ds.results_df.dropna(subset=["stat"])

    # same rule as before: |log2FC| >= LFC_MIN, ranked by the Wald statistic
    up   = res[res["log2FoldChange"] >= LFC_MIN].sort_values("stat", ascending=False)
    down = res[res["log2FoldChange"] <= -LFC_MIN].sort_values("stat", ascending=True)
    return {"up": up.head(n_genes).index.tolist(), "down": down.head(n_genes).index.tolist()}

derive_signature = derive_signature_deseq2      

def patient_score(sig):
    """Per-patient mean(up) - mean(down) across late DN cells."""
    late_dn.obs.drop(columns=["sig_up", "sig_down"], errors="ignore", inplace=True)
    out = pd.DataFrame(index=late_dn.obs[PATIENT_COL].unique())
    if sig["up"]:
        sc.tl.score_genes(late_dn, sig["up"], score_name="sig_up")
        out["sig_up"] = late_dn.obs.groupby(PATIENT_COL, observed=True)["sig_up"].mean()
    if sig["down"]:
        sc.tl.score_genes(late_dn, sig["down"], score_name="sig_down")
        out["sig_down"] = late_dn.obs.groupby(PATIENT_COL, observed=True)["sig_down"].mean()
    return out.get("sig_up", 0) - out.get("sig_down", 0)

def spearman_all(R, yr):
    """Column-wise Spearman between a rank matrix R (patients x features) and ranked y."""
    Rc = R - R.mean(axis=0)
    yc = yr - yr.mean()
    return (Rc * yc[:, None]).sum(axis=0) / np.sqrt((Rc**2).sum(axis=0) * (yc**2).sum())

def read_gmt(path, require_prefix=None):
    rows = []
    with open(path) as f:
        for line in f:
            parts = line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
            if len(parts) < 3:
                continue
            name, desc, genes = parts[0], parts[1], parts[2:]
            if require_prefix and not desc.startswith(require_prefix):
                continue
            rows += [(name, g) for g in genes if g]
    net = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=["source", "target"]).drop_duplicates()
    sizes = net.groupby("source").size()
    keep = sizes[(sizes >= MIN_SET) & (sizes <= MAX_SET)].index
    return net[net["source"].isin(keep)]

# ---------------- full-cohort signature and target ----------------
sig_full = derive_signature(labeled)
if sig_full is None:
    raise ValueError("Signature is empty on all labeled patients. Check the sample counts.")
sig_genes = set(sig_full["up"] + sig_full["down"])
print(len(sig_full["up"]), "up |", len(sig_full["down"]), "down")
y = patient_score(sig_full).loc[labeled]

# ---------------- early pseudobulk over ALL early cells ----------------
early_all = adata[is_early].copy()
detected = np.asarray((early_all.X > 0).mean(axis=0)).ravel()
genes = early_all.var_names[detected >= MIN_FRAC]
print(f"{len(genes)} genes kept from {early_all.n_vars}")

codes = pd.Categorical(early_all.obs[PATIENT_COL])
M = sp.csr_matrix((np.ones(early_all.n_obs),
                   (codes.codes, np.arange(early_all.n_obs))),
                  shape=(len(codes.categories), early_all.n_obs))
M = sp.diags(1 / np.asarray(M.sum(axis=1)).ravel()) @ M
early_pb = pd.DataFrame(to_dense(M @ early_all[:, genes].X),
                        index=codes.categories, columns=genes).loc[labeled]

# ---------------- jackknife targets, built once and reused for every database ----------------
jk_targets = {}
for held in labeled:
    train = [p for p in labeled if p != held]
    sig_j = derive_signature(train)
    if sig_j is None:
        print(f"jackknife skip {held}: no usable signature")
        continue
    jk_targets[held] = (train, patient_score(sig_j).loc[train])

# ---------------- per-database analysis ----------------
yr = rankdata(y.values)
ACT = {}

def score_database(net, db):
    out = dc.mt.ulm(data=early_pb, net=net)
    A = out[0] if isinstance(out, tuple) else out
    A = A.loc[labeled]
    A = A.loc[:, A.std() > 0]
    ACT[db] = A.copy()
    Ar = A.rank(axis=0).values

    # observed Spearman per pathway
    r = pd.Series(spearman_all(Ar, yr), index=A.columns)

    # exact permutation null: all orderings if n <= 8, otherwise random shuffles
    perms = list(permutations(range(n))) if n <= 8 else \
            [rng.permutation(n) for _ in range(N_PERM)]
    null_abs = np.array([np.abs(spearman_all(Ar, yr[list(p)])) for p in perms])  # perms x pathways
    # per-pathway exact p: fraction of permutations with |r| at least as large as observed
    p_exact = pd.Series((null_abs >= np.abs(r.values)).mean(axis=0), index=A.columns)
    # family-wise p within this database: fraction of permutations whose max |r| beats observed
    p_fwe = pd.Series((null_abs.max(axis=1)[:, None] >= np.abs(r.values)).mean(axis=0),
                      index=A.columns)

    # jackknife: sign consistency and minimum |r| across drop-one-patient analyses
    jk = []
    for held, (train, yj) in jk_targets.items():
        jk.append(pd.Series(spearman_all(A.loc[train].rank(axis=0).values, rankdata(yj.values)),
                            index=A.columns))
    jk = pd.DataFrame(jk)

    # fraction of each set's genes that are in the signature
    overlap = net.groupby("source")["target"].apply(
        lambda g: len(set(g) & sig_genes) / len(g)).reindex(A.columns)

    return pd.DataFrame({
        "database": db,
        "pathway": A.columns,
        "spearman_r": r.values,
        "p_exact": p_exact.values,
        "p_fwe_within_db": p_fwe.values,
        "jackknife_sign_consistency": (np.sign(jk) == np.sign(r)).mean(axis=0).values,
        "min_abs_r_jackknife": jk.abs().min().values,
        "signature_overlap": overlap.values,
    })

# ---------------- run all databases ----------------
tables = []
for db, (fname, prefix) in GMT_FILES.items():
    net = read_gmt(fname, require_prefix=prefix)
    print(f"{db}: {net['source'].nunique()} sets after size filter")
    tables.append(score_database(net, db))

results = pd.concat(tables, ignore_index=True)
results["q_bh_all"] = multipletests(results["p_exact"], method="fdr_bh")[1]
results = results.sort_values("p_exact").reset_index(drop=True)
results.to_csv("early_pathway_persistence_all_databases.csv", index=False)

# ---------------- per-patient activity in long format ----------------
act_long = (pd.concat(ACT, names=["database", "patient"])
              .reset_index()
              .melt(id_vars=["database", "patient"], var_name="pathway", value_name="activity")
              .dropna(subset=["activity"]))
act_long["persistence_score"] = act_long["patient"].map(y)
act_long.to_csv("early_pathway_activity_long.csv", index=False)
y.rename("persistence_score").to_csv("persistence_score_per_patient.csv")

print(results.head(20).round(3))
```

```{python}
import re
import pandas as pd

# ---------------- filter settings: decide these before looking at results ----------------
T_TERMS   = ("T_CELL", "TCELL", "TCR", "CD8", "CD4", "CD28", "LYMPHOCYTE", "MEMORY",
             "EFFECTOR", "EXHAUST", "TREG", "NAIVE", "CYTOTOX", "INTERLEUKIN", "INTERFERON",
             "IFN", "ANTIGEN", "MHC", "ACTIVATION", "PROLIFERAT", "IMMUNE", "LCK", "ZAP70",
             "PD_1", "PD-1", "CTLA4", "GRANZYME", "PERFORIN", "TBET", "EOMES", "IL7", "IL2", "IL15")
OFF_TERMS = ("NEUTROPHIL", "MONOCYTE", "MACROPHAGE", "DENDRITIC", "BASOPHIL", "PLASMACYTOID",
             "PLATELET", "ERYTHROCYTE", "CILI", "AXONEM", "NEURON", "INSULIN", "GLIAL",
             "SPERMAT", "OLFACT", "KERATIN", "PANCREAS", "HEPATO", "ADIPO", "MYOGEN")
OVERLAP_MAX   = 0.2     # drop sets sharing more than this fraction of genes with the signature
REDUNDANT_J   = 0.5     # collapse sets whose gene-level Jaccard similarity exceeds this
TOP_N         = 15      # per database, for the printed shortlist

def has_any(name, terms):
    u = name.upper()
    return any(t in u for t in terms)

# ---------------- load gene sets (needed for the redundancy step) ----------------
gene_sets = {}
for db, (fname, prefix) in GMT_FILES.items():
    net_db = read_gmt(fname, require_prefix=prefix)
    gene_sets[db] = net_db.groupby("source")["target"].apply(set).to_dict()

# ---------------- stage 1: relevance filter (keyword, applied to every database) ----------------
f = results.copy()
f["abs_r"] = f["spearman_r"].abs()
is_t = f["pathway"].apply(lambda s: has_any(s, T_TERMS))
is_off = f["pathway"].apply(lambda s: has_any(s, OFF_TERMS))
#f = f[is_t & ~(is_off & ~is_t)]   # keep T-relevant sets; off-target sets are already excluded
print(f"after relevance filter: {len(f)} sets")

# ---------------- stage 2: signature overlap and jackknife stability ----------------
f = f[(f["signature_overlap"] <= OVERLAP_MAX) & (f["jackknife_sign_consistency"] == 1.0)]
print(f"after overlap and jackknife filters: {len(f)} sets")

# ---------------- stage 3: collapse redundant sets within each database ----------------
def collapse(df_db, sets):
    kept = []
    for pw in df_db.sort_values(["abs_r", "p_exact"], ascending=[False, True])["pathway"]:
        g = sets.get(pw, set())
        if not g:
            continue
        redundant = any(len(g & sets[k]) / len(g | sets[k]) > REDUNDANT_J
                        for k in kept if k in sets)
        if not redundant:
            kept.append(pw)
    return df_db[df_db["pathway"].isin(kept)]

f = pd.concat([collapse(g, gene_sets[db]) for db, g in f.groupby("database")],
              ignore_index=True)
print(f"after redundancy collapse: {len(f)} sets")

# ---------------- stage 4: rank and save ----------------
f = f.sort_values(["abs_r", "p_exact"], ascending=[False, True]).reset_index(drop=True)
f.to_csv("early_pathway_filtered.csv", index=False)

for db, g in f.groupby("database"):
    print(f"\n{db}: top {TOP_N}")
    print(g[["pathway", "spearman_r", "p_exact", "q_bh_all", "signature_overlap"]]
          .head(TOP_N).round(3).to_string(index=False))
```

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

TOP_X = 4
dbs = results["database"].unique()
fig, axes = plt.subplots(len(dbs), TOP_X,
                         figsize=(3.6 * TOP_X, 3.4 * len(dbs)), squeeze=False)

for i, db in enumerate(dbs):
    top = results[results["database"] == db].head(TOP_X).reset_index(drop=True)
    for j in range(TOP_X):
        ax = axes[i, j]
        if j >= len(top):
            ax.set_visible(False)
            continue

        row = top.iloc[j]
        sub = act_long[(act_long["database"] == db) & (act_long["pathway"] == row["pathway"])]
        x = sub.set_index("patient")["activity"].reindex(labeled)
        yy = y.reindex(labeled)

        ax.scatter(x, yy, s=45, color="steelblue", edgecolor="k", zorder=3)
        for p in labeled:
            ax.annotate(p, (x[p], yy[p]), textcoords="offset points",
                        xytext=(4, 3), fontsize=7)

        ax.set_title(f"{db}\n{row['pathway'][:45]}\nρ={row['spearman_r']:.2f}, "
             f"p={row['p_exact']:.3f}, q={row['q_bh_all']:.2f}", fontsize=7)
        ax.set_xlabel("Early activity (ulm)", fontsize=7)
        ax.set_ylabel("Late persistence score", fontsize=7)
        ax.tick_params(labelsize=6)

fig.suptitle("Top early pathways per database vs late persistence score (n = 7)", fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("pathway_scatter_by_database.png", dpi=300)
plt.show()
```

```{python}
from scipy.stats import spearmanr

rows = []
for _, r in f.iterrows():
    db, pw = r["database"], r["pathway"]
    members = gene_sets[db].get(pw, set())
    act = ACT[db][pw].reindex(labeled)

    for g in sorted(members):
        measured = g in early_pb.columns
        row = {
            "database": db,
            "pathway": pw,
            "pathway_spearman_r": r["spearman_r"],
            "pathway_p_exact": r["p_exact"],
            "gene": g,
            "measured_early": measured,
            "in_signature": g in sig_genes,
            "signature_direction": ("up" if g in sig_full["up"]
                                    else "down" if g in sig_full["down"] else ""),
        }
        if measured:
            e = early_pb[g]
            row["mean_early_log_expr"] = e.mean()
            row["rho_with_pathway_activity"] = spearmanr(e, act)[0]
            row["rho_with_persistence"] = spearmanr(e, y)[0]
        rows.append(row)

gene_table = pd.DataFrame(rows)
gene_table["abs_rho_with_activity"] = gene_table["rho_with_pathway_activity"].abs()
gene_table = gene_table.sort_values(["database", "pathway", "abs_rho_with_activity"],
                                    ascending=[True, True, False])
gene_table.to_csv("early_pathway_member_genes.csv", index=False)
print(gene_table.groupby(["database", "pathway"]).agg(
    n_members=("gene", "size"),
    n_measured=("measured_early", "sum"),
    n_in_signature=("in_signature", "sum")).head(20))
```
